cards.h1: SIX WEAPON CLASSES. ONE RIGHT ANSWER.
cards.sub: What to mount, and when — slot for slot.

rows.t: Tempo. Stacks attack speed for crit-fishing and boss-meter racing.
Crowds. Extra multi-shot shines in Wave Zones and deep-space density.
Raw hit. A flat +20% makes it the best single-target slot in the game.
Crit scaling. Pairs with Targeting gear — big crits become absurd ones.
Sustain. Life steal keeps glass cannons alive in gunner-heavy zones.
Support. Aegis-only — a fleet-wide aura, doubled by the hull itself.

cards.caption: Six weapon classes. One right answer for YOUR build. ⌁ Full field manual on the site — play free in your browser → lootfleet.com #spacegame #browsergame #indiegame #lootfleet

cards.h1: CLASS + RARITY = THE REAL POWER MATH
cards.sub: Which drop actually wins the slot.

rows.t: Take the class your build scales with — the rarity is a wash.
The class bonus usually decides it — especially Missile's flat +20%.
Take the rarity. Almost always. The multiplier out-muscles any class.

cards.caption: Same rarity? Class wins. Two tiers apart? Rarity wins. The loot math that settles every drop → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #spacegame #gamingtips #browsergame

cards.sub: Every escort in the fleet feeds the flagship.

rows.t: Escorts contribute 30% of their hull bonuses to your live stats.

cards.caption: Your bench is not decoration. Escort hulls feed 30% of their mods, gear — and now their fighter wings — into the fight. Build the whole fleet → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #spacegame #fleetbuilding

cards.h1: YOUR MOON WORKS WHILE YOU SLEEP
cards.sub: The colony loop in three rules.

rows.t: They produce even while you're offline. Collect when you return.
Pirates raid every few hours — under-defended systems get knocked offline.
Fully terraform all six sectors to unlock the next moon — each one resource-biased.

cards.caption: Build it once, it pays forever. Mines produce while you're offline — just keep the pirates off them. Moon colonies in Loot Fleet → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #idlegame #spacegame

cards.fact: A single hit can never take more than 22% of your max hull.
cards.small: Sustained swarm pressure still kills — burst alone can't delete you. Build hull, not fear.
cards.caption: One hit can NEVER take more than 22% of your hull. The swarm can still get you though → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #gamingtips #spacegame

cards.big: BUYING A TOUR LEVEL IS PRORATED
cards.fact: At 40/100 XP, finishing the level costs 600 ◈ — not 1,000.
cards.small: You only ever pay for the XP you're missing. Past level 100, every level is another fitting crate — no ceiling.
cards.caption: Tour of Duty respects your grind: buying a level only charges the XP you're MISSING. 40/100 → 600 ◈ → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #seasonpass #spacegame

cards.fact: Take a tile and its fortress is yours at the rank it was built — never wiped, never reset to Rank 1.
cards.small: Captured citadels even ignore the build cap. It was won, not built.
cards.caption: Win the tile, keep the fortress — at FULL rank. Citadel warfare in My Galaxy → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #spacegame #territorywar

cards.fact: A carrier in your fleet launches its own wing — from its own deck, out of its own bays.

cards.fact: Every drop within 620px flies to your ship — accelerating as it closes.
cards.small: The autopilot only chases what's beyond the magnet, so you keep fighting instead of fetching.
cards.caption: Stop fetching. Anything within magnet range flies to YOU — and pickup radius gear widens the vacuum → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #gamingtips #spacegame
